decisions.text: behaviour: added INV-1..6 lines to the plan's own Architecture Impact (the arch check required them; the plan file is always writable) — reverse: restore the single INV-none line
behaviour: the unsaved-changes prompt uses the destructive confirm style for the 'leave' button (DESIGN.md D-7) — reverse: pass destructive: false in unsaved-changes.guard.ts
behaviour: the baby slot in the top bar stays empty until a later plan fills ShellService.babyLabel (DESIGN.md D-8) — reverse: none needed
behaviour: the health route reports db 'down' with HTTP 200 when the ping fails, rather than a 5xx — reverse: return 503 in server/routes/health.js
behaviour: the Hebrew copy for the four empty-state action buttons is my own wording, since the plan left it open — reverse: edit HE.pages in he.ts

seen: mongodb-memory-server's postinstall build script is ignored by pnpm (server install prints 'Ignored build scripts'); the tests passed in this run, but a fresh machine may need to download the mongod binary on first use
behaviour: logout also clears the baby kept in memory and the top-bar label, with no dialog — reverse: drop BabyService.reset() from SettingsPage.logout
behaviour: createIndexes runs from createApp (fire-and-forget) because server/index.js is outside scope — reverse: call it from index.js after connect
behaviour: a server-rejected baby save shows one generic message, HE.baby.invalid, on the name field — reverse: edit that string

behaviour: requireAuth is mounted per resource (/api/v1/baby) rather than on all of /api/v1, so an unknown /api/v1 path stays 404 for anonymous callers — reverse: mount it on /api/v1 before the routers
behaviour: the e2e specs for plan 001 now sign in and save a baby first, since the guards need that — reverse: revert the e2e/001-*.spec.ts edits
behaviour: the shell hides the bottom nav on /login and /welcome using the router URL — reverse: revert the showNav_ condition in shell.ts

behaviour: the catalog middleware seeds the built-ins on every catalog request (two cheap queries) and answers 409 no_baby when the household has no baby — reverse: seed only on the first GET and drop the check in server/routes/catalog-helpers.js

behaviour: DELETE of a built-in food or allergen archives it, and DELETE of an allergen that any food references (archived foods included) archives it — reverse: change the checks in server/routes/foods.js and server/routes/allergens.js
behaviour: after saving or archiving a food the app returns to /foods with no toast, and the unsaved-changes prompt is skipped on those exits — reverse: drop the leaving_ flag in food-form.ts
behaviour: the new-food form starts with category `ירקות` and no emoji, and the save button stays disabled until an emoji is chosen — reverse: change the EMPTY defaults in food-form.ts
behaviour: a warning with empty text is stored as no warning, even if an age is filled in — reverse: change parseWarning in server/lib/catalog-validation.js
behaviour: allergens are renamed inline with a `שמירת שם` button or Enter, with no confirmation — reverse: remove the button and the keydown handler in allergens-manage.html
seen: src/app/pages/allergens/allergens.ts — the old `אלרגנים` nav tab still shows a placeholder page next to the new /foods/allergens page; plan 003 does not touch it

behaviour: the engine adds intro.givenDates (the counted given days) so the badge shows the true n/N ordinal even when earlier days are off-screen — reverse: drop the field and count from the loaded calendar items

behaviour: tapping an alert shows the suggested food first in the add-food sheet under 'מוצע' with an accent outline, and adds nothing until the parent taps it — reverse: add it directly on the alert tap

behaviour: the alert strip is rewritten so a tappable alert is one row (text and chevron, 4px bad-colour bar at the inline-start) that collapses to 3 rows with '+N נוספות'; the old action-button rows still work — reverse: restore the previous alert-strip files from git
behaviour: on /allergens with no allergens, the empty state's action opens /foods/allergens — reverse: remove manage() in allergens-page.ts
behaviour: PUT /api/v1/settings refuses unknown keys with 400 invalid and merges accepted values over the previously stored ones — reverse: ignore unknown keys in validateSettings
removes: the placeholder src/app/pages/allergens/allergens.{ts,html} empty-state page is replaced by the real allergens page (the plan names the route change) — reverse: git revert this commit
seen: src/app/core/i18n/he.ts — HE.pages.allergens is now only used for emptyAction; the other keys there are unused placeholders

behaviour: the old inline accept and ✕ buttons on a suggested tile are replaced by one dashed tile that opens the reason sheet, as the UI notes say — reverse: restore the two buttons in week-view.html
behaviour: PUT /foods/queue must list every queued food exactly once, otherwise 400 — reverse: relax the check in routes/foods.js
behaviour: suggestions are cleared when the visible week or the view changes — reverse: drop the effect in calendar-page.ts

behaviour: rule 3 (start the next allergen) is skipped when a not_started allergen already has planned items; it runs before the maintenance rule so the start days take priority — reverse: change the order or condition in suggestions.js
behaviour: an archived food cannot be added to the queue (400); removing it from the queue is still allowed — reverse: drop the check in the queue route

behaviour: editing a reaction never changes its locks, and a photo removed in the edit form is not deleted from Cloudinary (photos are deleted only when the whole reaction is deleted) — reverse: destroy the removed photos in the PATCH route in server/routes/reactions.js

behaviour: a food locked through its allergen shows 🔒 on /foods with no release button; it is released from /allergens — reverse: show the 🔓 button for any locked food in foods-page.html and let the foods release route fall back to the allergen lock
behaviour: the item-tile badge now also shows for non-allergen foods when the food is locked (🔒 on a bad-colour fill) — reverse: restrict the badge to allergen foods in item-tile.html
behaviour: the reaction time field is a datetime-local input, so app-text-field accepts that type — reverse: drop the type from text-field.ts and use a date field plus a time field
behaviour: the reactions list shows a plain empty message with no action button (the shared empty-state needs an action) — reverse: add an action to the empty state

seen: server/test/reactions.test.js and the other server tests print 'index creation failed MongoClientClosedError' at teardown (createIndexes in server/app.js:25 races with the DB close). The tests pass; the message is noise from before this plan
behaviour: POST /api/v1/settings/reset answers { settings: {...defaults} } like GET and PUT, not the bare object — reverse: return withDefaults({}) directly in server/routes/settings.js

behaviour: the activity log leaves out seeded catalog entries (updatedBy 'system') and shows each document once with its latest change, per the planner decision — reverse: drop the updatedBy filter in activity-repository.js
behaviour: a failed progress or hint request shows nothing extra: the foods list still loads and the hint stays hidden — reverse: show an error state in foods-page or calendar-hint
behaviour: /?add=<foodId> opens the add sheet once the catalog loads, then removes the param from the URL — reverse: keep the param in openAddFromQuery()

seen: server activity shows usernames as stored (e.g. 'Parent-A' for APP_USERS casing); the [ui] item expects 'parent-a' — check E2E_USERNAME and APP_USERS casing before running e2e/008-3 (server/test/helpers.js:7)
